title: Bacon Wrapped Chicken Breast with Confit
description: A keto-friendly dish combining the richness of confit with the savory taste of bacon wrapped chicken breast.
instructions: Season the chicken breasts with umami seasoning.
Wrap each chicken breast with 2 slices of bacon.
Place the bacon wrapped chicken breasts on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
While the chicken is baking, heat the confit in a saucepan over medium heat.
Once the chicken is done, brush with the heated confit.
Reduce heat to low and cover with polish sausage drippings.
